cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
三天 4,779 星
逐块改写成 Rust 的 skill
cover.dek: rust-anything 按模块逐段把应用改写成 Rust，每一步都用原程序录下的行为校验。X 上几乎没人聊，热度来自 YouTube 和 HN。
cover.title_en:
4,779 stars in three days
for a skill that rewrites apps in Rust
cover.dek_en: rust-anything ports an app to Rust one module at a time and checks each step against behavior recorded from the original program. It barely registers on X, and the attention comes from YouTube and HN.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: Folio 在 LOCA-bench 做对 66/75 题，摘要压缩的对照只有 54 题
stickers.text_en: Folio solves 66 of 75 LOCA-bench tasks. The summary-compression baseline solves 54.

stickers.title: 新风向
stickers.text: NVIDIA 的 SkillEvaluator 和 SkillSpector 上榜，专做 skill 评测与安全
stickers.text_en: NVIDIA's SkillEvaluator and SkillSpector made the list, both built to test and vet skills.

stickers.title: 曝光账
stickers.text: orca 的清单视频有 ▶102,777，评测视频合计只有约 ▶5,100
stickers.text_en: orca's list video drew ▶102,777 views. Its review videos total about ▶5,100.
